changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset name to 'ProxyQA', consolidated task descriptions, added missing models mentioned in the paper (LLaMA2-7B, Alpaca, GPT-3.5-turbo, Gemini Pro), removed redundant/variant names, and added long-form QA as an additional task since the paper explicitly discusses this as a related field.
Consolidated all proxy-question accuracy variants under the base metric 'Accuracy' as they all refer to the same evaluation approach of measuring accuracy on answering proxy questions.
Normalized model names, clarified the two distinct pairwise evaluation methods (GPT-S and GPT-B) mentioned in the paper, and standardized criteria naming.

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on evaluating long-form text generation through a novel proxy-question framework. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of redundant entries. The paper explicitly mentions human evaluation with 5 postgraduate students and uses GPT-4/GPT-4-Turbo as evaluators. The main contribution is the ProxyQA benchmark and evaluation methodology.
